name: Meilin Qiu
career: Project coordinator for a nonprofit that builds mobile STEM learning labs for elementary schools
bio: Meilin spends her weekdays juggling school partnerships, grant timelines, and lesson pilots, then unwinds at night with boxing interviews, old-school hip-hop conversations, and the occasional true crime binge after her son falls asleep. She is serious about building long-term financial freedom, so her notes app is full of side-business ideas, productivity systems, and grocery price comparisons before every Aldi run. On weekends she rotates between church, trying new home-cooked recipes, and helping a neighborhood cleanup crew keep a local park usable for kids. A slightly unexpected hobby of hers is collecting vinyl copies of soul records and teaching herself finger drumming on a beat pad when she needs to clear her head.

Instagram.style_description: Meilin uses Instagram as her most lifestyle-forward space: upbeat, curated, and visually tidy without feeling overly performative. She posts selectively about family moments, recipes, workouts, and small wins, but spends more time watching funny reels, fitness clips, hip-hop content, and limited-time shopping posts than writing long captions.

Facebook.style_description: On Facebook, Meilin is warmer, more practical, and more community-oriented. She shares occasional family updates, comments on neighborhood events, reacts to community cleanup or school-related posts, and is more likely to engage with people she knows offline than with creators.

Threads.style_description: Threads is where Meilin is a little more off-the-cuff, witty, and conversational. She is more likely to drop short reactions about boxing, movie buzz, everyday frustrations, productivity thoughts, or funny parenting-adjacent observations than to post personal updates.

Chatbot.style_description: With an AI chatbot, Meilin is utilitarian but thoughtful. She uses it as a private planning partner for work, routines, side-business ideas, and emotional decompression, often aiming for clear structure, encouraging language, and actionable next steps.
